name: Kettlebell Complex Workout
description: A 30-minute kettlebell complex workout featuring a series of compound movements performed in sequence.

exercises.name: Kickstand rows
exercises.description: Bent-over row with one foot elevated behind for stability, pulling the kettlebell up towards the chest.
exercises.notes: Maintain a flat back and engage the core; use the non-working leg for balance.

exercises.name: Kettlebell clean
exercises.description: Explosive lift from the ground to the rack position at the shoulder, keeping the elbow high.
exercises.notes: Drive through the heels and keep the kettlebell close to the body during the pull.

exercises.name: Kettlebell press
exercises.description: Press the kettlebell from the rack position overhead until the arm is fully extended.
exercises.notes: Keep the core tight and avoid arching the back; press straight up.

exercises.name: Kettlebell snatch
exercises.description: One-arm overhead lift from the ground to full extension in one fluid motion.
exercises.notes: Use a hip hinge and explosive pull; keep the arm straight during the lockout.

circuit.notes: Perform all exercises in sequence without rest, then repeat the entire circuit once.

sequence.flow: Kickstand rows → Kettlebell clean → Kettlebell press → Kettlebell snatch
sequence.notes: Complete the sequence continuously; maintain rhythm and proper form throughout.
